summary: BOTH BUG FIXES VERIFIED. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (test_session_admin_orders.py). (1) Session persistence: whitelist login (admin+buyer) -> /api/auth/me 200; invalid token -> 401; missing token -> 401; logout -> token invalidated server-side (/me -> 401). UI E2E (20/20 assertions): admin login -> full page reload -> still on /home (no login screen); goto / -> gated to /home; logout -> login screen -> reload stays logged out; injected garbage token -> /me 401 -> token cleared from localStorage -> redirected to login (regression holds). (2) Admin pesanan management: all 5 filter chips render and filter correctly; clicking 'Konfirmasi Pembayaran Diterima' on a menunggu_konfirmasi order moved it to sedang_dikemas (verified in UI filter + DB history); dikirim order shows resi-edit field PREFILLED with existing resi (TR-TEST-2) + 'Update Resi / Tracking' updates resi to TR-TEST-UI-9 WITHOUT a duplicate status_history entry (history stayed ['menunggu_pembayaran','sedang_dikemas','dikirim'] through resi-only update, then single 'selesai' appended by Tandai Selesai); 'Tandai Selesai' moved the order to selesai (gone from Dikirim filter, present under Selesai, DB confirms). Regression: menunggu_pembayaran orders show 'Proses -> Sedang Dikemas'; sedang_dikemas orders show resi input + 'Kirim -> Dikirim' (verified both in UI after transitions). Validation: dikirim without resi -> 400, bogus status -> 400, buyer PUT status -> 401/403. No red screens, no console errors (only expected 404s for non-existent TEST bukti image files). No deprecated expo packages found.

minor.issue: Sets status=menunggu_konfirmasi via $set WITHOUT pushing a status_history entry (unlike /konfirmasi-bayar which does push). Observed on TEST order 9de2489e: history jumps menunggu_pembayaran -> sedang_dikemas with no menunggu_konfirmasi row. Pre-existing, outside this fix scope, but inconsistent audit trail.

issues: 'Konfirmasi Pembayaran Diterima' button label wraps to 2 lines on 375px width — readable and tappable, minor cosmetic note only

action_items: Optional: make POST /api/orders/{id}/bukti push a 'menunggu_konfirmasi' status_history entry for a consistent audit trail.
Optional: server.py is 1284 lines — split auth/orders/chat/socket into modules per 700-line guideline.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx loadFromToken correctly clears the token ONLY on ApiError 401 — network failures keep the token, matching the bug-fix intent; verified invalid-token path clears localStorage and redirects to login.
server.py:894 pushes status_history only when status != doc.status — resi-only updates are deduped; verified via API (history length unchanged) and via UI-driven update.
client.ts memoizes the token in memory AND persists via storage.secureSet (AsyncStorage/localStorage on web) — reload persistence verified.
Root layout gate correctly routes unauthenticated -> /login and authenticated -> /home on both reload and direct URL navigation.
seed_data_creation: TEST orders created for UI flow (product TEST_SessOrders, buyer 'Pembeli Demo'): 9de2489e (konfirmasi click -> now sedang_dikemas), 5c30a311 (resi updated to TR-TEST-UI-9 -> now selesai), 423678d8 (sedang_dikemas), 4a862c8d (menunggu_pembayaran) + 3 extra menunggu_pembayaran from validation tests. Seeded orders DS-260913-D86E (dikirim, TR-1) and DS-260913-F570 (selesai) left untouched. NOTE: DS-260913-B889 is now sedang_dikemas (confirmed before this run, likely by E1's smoke test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_session_admin_orders.py (run serially with -o addopts='' since pytest.ini enables xdist; ui_orders pytest attr is per-run only — query GET /api/orders as admin to find TEST orders by item name TEST_SessOrders). UI selectors: M3TextField renders testID on wrapper View -> use '[data-testid="username-input"] input'. Resi TextInput on web: '[data-testid="resi-edit-<id>"] input' when present, else the testID element itself. Token in localStorage key 'diana_session_token' as JSON string. 404 console noise comes from non-existent TEST bukti image URLs — harmless.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (re-login after app exit): previously any /api/auth/me failure (including network errors) wiped the stored token; fix restricts clearing to HTTP 401 only — verified. Bug 2 (no admin payment confirmation / tracking update): PUT /api/orders/<id>/status now skips status_history push when status unchanged, and admin UI gained Perlu Konfirmasi filter + 'Konfirmasi Pembayaran Diterima' (menunggu_konfirmasi -> sedang_dikemas), editable prefilled resi + 'Update Resi / Tracking' and 'Tandai Selesai' on dikirim orders — all verified end-to-end in UI + DB.
